# Length budgets per component class

<!-- Generated by `CUOTAI_REGENERATE_DOCS=1 cargo test -p cuotai-core length_budget`; do not edit. -->

PRD 0035 RF9.2: the longest text of each component class in every shipped language, measured on the real catalogs, against the class budget. Widths are display columns: a Han, kana or Hangul character counts two, a combining mark zero, any other character one; placeholders take their widest sample (`{d}` = 99, `{p}` = 100, `{at}` = a 5-character time). Components are laid out against the budget, not the English text. A label over its budget is reworded by the translator (RF9.3), never truncated by the UI; `cargo test -p cuotai-core length_budget` fails on a new one. Entries marked `*` are over budget today and waiting for that rewording.

Ids per class:

- **Pace chip (points)** (core): `pace.chip.ahead`, `pace.chip.reserve`, `pace.chip.on_pace`, `pace.chip.exhausted`, `pace.chip.lasts`, `pace.chip.runs_out`.
- **Pace chip (percent)** (core): `pace.chip.ahead_pct`, `pace.chip.reserve_pct`.
- **Time chip** (core): `resets.chip.returns`, `resets.chip.return_unknown`.
- **Button** (desktop UI): `common.refresh`, `common.refreshAll`, `common.add`, `common.edit`, `common.remove`, `common.cancel`, `common.save`, `common.open`, `common.quit`, `common.back`, `common.show`, `common.hide`, `common.close`, `common.dismiss`, `common.details`.
- **Tab** (desktop UI): `tabs.all`, `tabs.more`.
- **State chip** (desktop UI): `freshness.fresh`, `freshness.aging`, `freshness.stale`, `status.needs_configuration`, `status.unsupported`, `status.authentication_error`, `status.rate_limited`, `status.error`, `stage.ahead`, `stage.on_pace`, `stage.reserve`, `stage.exhausted`.
- **Sort option** (desktop UI): `sort.custom`, `sort.binding`.
